decision: Born from a dogfood: operator pasted the capability 'Setup incomplete' card command (`dontpanic capabilities status … > …json`) and nothing changed, because status is a read-only diagnostic that never resolves setup. Root cause in operator_console.provide_capability_actions (~line 590): needs_setup/blocked/not_installed cards emit exact_command=`dontpanic capabilities status <id>` even though the code comment (~546) explicitly states status does NOT resolve them. Same render-truth/action-resolvability dishonesty as 001/004/005, applied to exact_command choice.

Reviewer-tightened scope (two corrections to the first proposal): (1) The card action is GUIDANCE not a fix — `capabilities setup <id> --print-steps` only PLANS; bare `capabilities setup <id>` refuses (exit 2, capabilities_setup.py:~240) demanding --print-steps or --automate-safe --confirm. So frame the action 'Show setup steps', never 'Repair'/'Fix'. (2) Auto-executing setup steps must NOT be folded into the 2026-06-04-006 --safe-derived-state tier: installing CLIs / registering adapters / touching credentials are not derived-state repairs, and manifests are MIXED (agent-claude-cli.json: install_claude_cli automatable=true, authenticate_claude automatable=false/human-credential, line ~63). Any future auto-exec must be PER-STEP with explicit safety/tier metadata in a SEPARATE tier — a later distinct plan, scoped OUT here.

Scope = 3 honesty/clarity fixes only: F001 resolving command on the card (setup --print-steps, honest consequence, keep operator_attested+capability_ready), F002 plain-language detail from setup_steps[].what + human reasons (fallback to missing-summary), F003 dashboard 'Global tools' vs 'Tracked projects' labelling. Explicitly OUT: auto-execution, new manifests, changes to capabilities setup execution semantics. status:draft; pre_impl is the human gate. Captured as feedback memory feedback_operator_card_resolving_guidance.

Pre-lock refinement (reviewer-directed) to remove plan-review friction before implementation: (1) Split the former F003 into F003 (producer/data: capability items + exported state carry a `global_tool_setup` group label) + F004 (dashboard rendering: 'Global tools' vs 'Tracked projects'), resolving the over_surface(cli+dashboard) warn. (2) Tightened F001 acceptance to avoid prose-symbol false positives — phrased as 'emitted command is `dontpanic capabilities setup <id> --print-steps`; card stays non-automatable and clears only after a later capability re-probe reports ready' instead of bare words like needs_setup/operator_attested/capability_ready (those remain in the F001 DESCRIPTION, which the linter does not block on). (3) Scope boundary kept explicit: --print-steps is guidance only; NO --automate-safe --confirm; NO reuse of 006 derived-state tier; future setup automation is per-step and separate.

LOCK: plan-review verdict OK (0 block-severity after the D004 refinement; the lone F004 over_surface warn is a benign classifier false-positive on the word 'projects' — splitting into an identical F004a child would be noise, so left as-is). Operator authorized lock+build; status draft->active, pre_impl cleared by operator. Build order operator-style red/green TDD: F001 producer command/consequence -> F002 plain-language detail -> F003 producer global_tool_setup label -> F004 dashboard 'Global tools' grouping. pre_merge remains the human gate; branch stays unmerged.

Built 4/4 operator-style red/green TDD. F001+F002: operator_console.provide_capability_actions now emits exact_command `dontpanic capabilities setup <id> --print-steps` + plain_consequence 'Prints the setup steps for <id> so you can complete it.' (was `capabilities status <id>` / 'Shows the current status detail'); detail built from cap.next_actions[].what (+ '(needs you)' for human-required steps), fallback to 'missing:' summary when no steps. Kept automatable=False + operator_attested + capability_ready clears_when. F003: action_renderers.action_view tags capability-source items with group='global_tool_setup' (GROUP_GLOBAL_TOOL_SETUP); other items group=None. F004: dashboard/lib/what-now-logic.js renderGlobalToolsHTML(items) renders group==global_tool_setup under a 'Global tools' heading + 'Install-level — not tied to any project' copy ('' when none), wired (escaped) into pages/what-now/what-now.js prepended to every view. Updated ONE existing test (test_action_resolvability_f004 needs_setup command assertion) to the corrected honest command — it had encoded the old `capabilities status firebase` (feature_defect class, the plan's whole point). 6 new py tests + 4 new vitest tests; full Python sweep 3918 passed/7 skipped, dashboard vitest 953 passed/44 files, no regressions. Scope held: NO auto-exec, NO --automate-safe, NO 006 derived-state tier reuse.

CLOSE: 4/4 features built + verified, status active->completed. Full Python orchestrate sweep 3918 passed / 7 skipped; dashboard vitest 953 passed / 44 files. operator_verified close (no paid audit — local copy/wiring fix, well covered by 10 new tests + 1 corrected existing test). pre_merge remains the human gate; branch stays unmerged. Durable follow-up (OUT of this plan, per D002/scope-out): per-step setup auto-execution with its own safety tier, distinct from the 006 derived-state repair tier — a future plan, demand-gated.
